No export scaling.", "simplification": "Meaning-specific reconstruction with original 1.4 mm strokes and freshly sampled 1.2 mm Index dots. Selected adult female Araneus composite cutaway retains the body boundary, dorsal heart and anterior aorta, mouth-to-sucking-stomach and post-stomach gut to midgut, stercoral region and anus, one representative near book lung with its air opening, and projected ovary territory with genital opening. Vertical organ spacing is independently enlarged relative to horizontal spacing; small organ outlines and opening connectors keep physical size. The stercoral region is moved slightly inward to retain a 13 mm anus connector; its gut attachment is moved to the upper surface to avoid a narrow doubled-back connector. This remains a composite relation model, not a literal single section, diagnostic anatomy or complete paired-organ count. No external legs or new organs are introduced.", "canvas_mm": [165, 180]}, "teaching": "Selected adult female Araneus composite cutaway retains the body boundary, dorsal heart and anterior aorta, mouth-to-sucking-stomach and post-stomach gut to midgut, stercoral region and anus, one representative near book lung with its air opening, and projected ovary territory with genital opening. Vertical organ spacing is independently enlarged relative to horizontal spacing; small organ outlines and opening connectors keep physical size. The stercoral region is moved slightly inward to retain a 13 mm anus connector; its gut attachment is moved to the upper surface to avoid a narrow doubled-back connector. This remains a composite relation model, not a literal single section, diagnostic anatomy or complete paired-organ count. No external legs or new organs are introduced.
